answer: Require every identity key to be born inside a distinct hardware secure enclave that signs a proof of its own uniqueness. Like a voyage that can only cross one ridge at a time, a single chip yields exactly one attested key: the enclave refuses to mint a second, and its signature cannot be copied to another machine. A nebula of fake accounts would then demand a warehouse of real chips, so each Sybil costs full hardware instead of a free software clone.
